description: The research team publishes the 2023 Hospital Online Service Provision Index observations for Portuguese hospital websites. The index records online content, services, community interaction and technical features, with item-level variables described in the accompanying paper. The University of Minho data repository exposes a named tab-delimited dataset through a public file page and records CC0 1.0 in its dataset API, so access and reuse are free. The table can parameterise digital-service availability at hospitals in health-infrastructure or service-access simulations. It measures websites, not clinical capacity, operating reliability or patient outcomes. The 2023 web snapshot may have changed, and individual indicator coding requires the article and codebook. Dataset rows were not downloaded or tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified. These limits prevent the index from standing in for clinical service capacity. Use as a clinical-service measure is limited.
name: HOSPI Application to Portuguese Hospitals 2023
notes: G4-0503; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
